name: Akuma to Okama to Watashi
original_name: アクマとオカマとワタシ
source:
"...There shall be a splendid feast tonight..."

In the night, a girl managed to summon a demon to a school.
Her wish had been granted, but the demon wants her soul in return.

Will she manage to escape the school safely...?

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/5593]Freem![/url]]
translation:
“今夜将有一场盛大的宴会……”

一天夜里，一名女孩成功在学校里召唤出恶魔。她的愿望实现了，但恶魔要她的灵魂作为交换。

她能平安逃离学校吗……？

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/5593]Freem![/url]]
